title: "Modules"

## Story in one minute

This site has **four modules**. Each module has four short branches—like four chapters in a small book. You can read one page on its own, or follow the order below from plant to cup to body to history to decisions.

Nothing here requires a science degree. Each page opens with a short story, then explains what is going on, then says what it means when you drink tea or make a choice.

## The four modules

| Module | What it covers (in plain words) | Page |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 1. The Chemical Core | Tea plants, how leaves turn into green or black tea, brewing, and the main active compounds in the cup | [Open Module 1](module-01.qmd) |
| 2. Body, Brain & Mood | How caffeine and L-theanine relate to alertness, calm, stress hormones, and simple body measures | [Open Module 2](module-02.qmd) |
| 3. History, Ritual & Warmth | Trade and empire, monastic use, warm-cup effects on trust, and ritual as a stress break | [Open Module 3](module-03.qmd) |
| 4. Decisions & Choices | Fast vs careful thinking, risk and waiting for payoffs, trust games, and how studies are designed | [Open Module 4](module-04.qmd) |

## Branch map (same structure as the source packs)

Each module follows the same four-branch pattern used in the owner’s source packs. That makes it easy to go back and forth between the site and the packs.

| Module | The four branches |
| --- | --- |
| 1. Chemical Core | Plants · Oxidation (green vs black) · Brewing · Compounds |
| 2. Body & mind | How drinks act in the brain (plain terms) · Brain-wave patterns · Stress hormones · Body signals |
| 3. Socio-ritual | Trade history · Monastic history · Warmth and trust · Ritual and stress |
| 4. Decision | Dual-process thinking · Risk and waiting · Games of trust · Study protocols |

## Suggested reading paths

**“I just want to know what’s in my cup.”**  
Start with [Cup reference](../cup-reference.qmd), then [Module 1](module-01.qmd) sections 1.3 and 1.4.

**“Why do I feel awake but not jittery with tea?”**  
Read [Module 2](module-02.qmd), then the linkages page on L-theanine timing and calm brain waves.

**“Is tea only about chemistry?”**  
No. Read [Module 3](module-03.qmd) on trade, monasteries, warm mugs, and brewing breaks.

**“Do drinks change how people choose?”**  
Read [Module 4](module-04.qmd)—with the caveats that lab doses are not the same as your everyday mug.
